title: Homogeneity of weighted forms
statement:
Let $I$ be finite, let $w:I	o br$, let $p,rho,t
ein br$, and let $f:I	o br$. Define $G(g)=sum_iw_i|g_i|^p$ and $F(g)=rho^2sum_iw_ig_i^2+(1-rho^2)(sum_iw_ig_i)^2$. Then $G(tf)=|t|^pG(f)$ and $F(tf)=t^2F(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: p, ρ, and t are real
replaced: Let $I$ be finite, $w:I\to\bbr$, and $p,\rho,t\in\bbr$. Define $G(f)=\sum_iw_i|f_i|^p$ and $F(f)=\rho^2\sum_iw_if_i^2+(1-\rho^2)(\sum_iw_if_i)^2$. Then $G(tf)=|t|^pG(f)$ and $F(tf)=t^2F(f)$ for every real vector $f$.
